scope: UI snapshot, stale actions, connection boundaries and late async callbacks; engineering source/actual-ESM only

closed_findings.original_fixed_counterexample: Old connection prepare/status overwrote new connection route profiles.
closed_findings.resolution: Local result is published only with original page/connection and current statusSerial; invalidation clears configuration, selected subject/security and company options, then reads current configuration and roster. Roster reads use a separate connection/serial guard and no stale finally unlock.
closed_findings.independent_red_to_green: independent-prepare-config-boundary now passes against the same previously failing scenario.

source_review: Four last-good tables remain visible only within their connection; stale errors disable old buttons and action entrances check fresh current connection.
Per-read serial rejects older successes and older errors; stale read states prevent completion recommendations.
POST success/error/finally callbacks check current page generation and exact status object; reconnect invalidates previews and busy state without accepting old callbacks.
Preparation configuration and roster now reject late cross-connection responses and same-connection obsolete configuration responses; current roster replaces rather than appends old member options.
Task capabilities read current product.status rather than the original execution closure.
Backend owner capabilities, grants, receipts, retry and delivery policies are unchanged; UI state never grants authority.
